status_meaning: validated = every entry of validation.checks is true; it is not an on-device measurement.
supersedes: T6 static-fleet results and the T7 cycle files as the reference BOLOS numbers.

measurement_host.environment: dedicated Boat managed VM, size large (8 vCPU / 16 GiB RAM)

targets.nanosp: Nano S+, app built with -mcpu=cortex-m35p+nodsp, kernel IR triple thumbv8m.main-none-eabi, ELF ledger.api_level 27, QEMU runtime API verified for every launch
targets.nanox: Nano X, app built with -mcpu=cortex-m3, kernel IR triple thumbv6m-none-eabi, ELF ledger.api_level 27, QEMU runtime API verified for every launch

harness_command: bash b1_build.sh   # both trees at one build path, every variant built twice
t7_abba.py prepare --baseline art/ref --candidate art/lean --client-root src/app-bitcoin --profile testnet-perf --output run1 --build-evidence build_evidence.json

validation.decision_rule: Unit = one block (cycle, device, phase) of four Speculos launches, two per label, ordered ABBA or BAAB. Block statistic = (mean of the two B launches - mean of the two A launches) / mean of the two A launches. In the AB phase A is the reference ELF and B the Lean ELF; in the AA phase both labels run the reference ELF (placebo). A block is dropped when the harness marked any of its launches contaminated. A cell (device, scenario) is called faster or slower only if all three hold on the AB phase: Holm-adjusted two-sided paired-t p < 0.05 within its family (primary: SIGN_PSBT_TR_3IN, SIGN_PSBT_WSH3OF5_3IN, REGISTER_WALLET on both devices; secondary: the four other scenarios on both devices), exact sign-flip p < 0.05, and |mean block statistic| greater than the |placebo mean| of the same cell. Otherwise the cell is not distinguishable from noise. Sizes are exact integers read from the ELFs.

decision_rule_fixed_before_run.attestation: self-declared: written by b1_run.sh on the VM before the first launch, not by a third party

limitations: Latency is host wall-clock time of APDU exchanges against Speculos (QEMU user-mode emulation); it ranks the two ELFs on this host and is not a time on a physical device.
The latency ELFs are testnet builds with AUTOAPPROVE_FOR_PERF_TESTS=1. Mainnet production ELFs are listed for size only and were not timed.
worst_case_stack_bytes is a static estimate from the disassembly call graph (direct calls only, recursion cut); total_arm_thumb_insns is a static count of emitted instructions, not executed ones.
The VM is a guest on a shared hypervisor: two cores are pinned, not reserved.
A 14-launch pilot of the same harness ran before the measured run to check that it starts and to size the run; its samples were discarded and were not compared between the two ELFs.

The hub Python environment lacked base58, which the upstream test_utils import; base58 2.1.1 was installed from PyPI into a side directory on the VM. It is client-side only and identical for both ELFs.
The x86_64 rdtscp hotspot table and the host unit-test timings of the previous file are not reproduced here: neither is a measurement of a device ELF.

The four frozen ELF binaries are not committed (the repository ignores *.elf). Their SHA-256 are in frozen_elfs and in manifest.json, and every build was reproduced bit for bit on the VM from the listed commits.
